general_rule: A dimension surrogate key carried by a fact-like dimension row has mutation role frozen_from_first_encounter: it is bound from the dimension version current when the natural identity is first encountered and is never rewritten by later lifecycle updates of that identity. The rule names semantic roles, not account or trade identifiers.
why_constructed: DIGen scale-factor-3 Batch2 and Batch3 contain no Account CDC row for account 428, so the coincidence of an account version change before a trade completion had to be constructed. The trade rows are real Batch2 records; the account rollover is injected and labeled.
wrong_composition: MERGE ... WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET status_id = src.status_id, ..., sk_account_id = src.sk_account_id, sk_customer_id = src.sk_customer_id; every foreign key stays non-null and valid against the current dimension, grain holds, and historical ownership silently changes.
wrong_composition_downstream: With the rebind, FactHoldings attributes the 5225->0 close to the rollover version while the open stays on the earlier version: position_by_account shows +5225 on one version and -5225 on the other. Every row is FK-valid.
